correctness.rationale: The T6 vertices are 15 edges of K6; every open neighborhood contains 8 vertices. Exactly all faces from these 15 neighborhoods yield f=(15,105,420,945,840,420,120,15). The integral boundary matrices built from oriented simplices have verified exact rational ranks (14,91,329,525,315,105,15), hence reduced rational homology only in degree 3, rank 91. Hopf alternating trace of fixed oriented simplices across all 11 S6 conjugacy classes gives χ=(1,1,-3,-3,1,-1,1,7,7,-13,91); rational Specht inner products give the eight-part decomposition, no trivial line and one sign line. Transfer of rational homology to finite-group quotient and restriction to A6 yield the quotient results. A disconnected seven-edge induced subgraph of line graph must consist of disjoint endpoint families; max 7=binom(4,2)+binom(2,2), establishing the seven-cut facet equivalence. Independently enumerated all faces, modular boundary ranks over 1000003, fixed-face traces and exact class character; included rational verifier uses fractions.Fraction, so modular work alone is not taken as rational certification.
residual_risks: Finite exact chain and character calculations are essential; they do not infer larger-n behavior.
